ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Via comctl32.dll
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential DLL sideloading using comctl32.dll to obtain system privileges Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\logonUI\\\.exe\\\.local\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\werFault\\\.exe\\\.local\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\consent\\\.exe\\\.local\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\narrator\\\.exe\\\.local\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\windows\\\\system32\\\\wermgr\\\.exe\\\.local\\\\")) AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\comctl32\\\.dll$"))
